scope: Runtime appearance acceptance and test reliability

official_evidence.observation: SettingsViewModel binds the system/dark/light appearance selection.
official_evidence.limits: Official storage scope, lifecycle timing and all presentation owners remain independently scoped.

independent_adaptation: XCTest changes simulator appearance while existing surfaces remain open. This validates the reconstructed host; it does not establish official visual parity.

validation.visual: Menu/keyboard, Chat/Work text preview, local browser and Chinese/English loaded PDF light-dark pairs inspected
validation.limits: Only the listed surfaces and synthetic flows are accepted; component-wide contrast, exact official parity and remaining floating surfaces remain open

failed_and_superseded_runs.r1: Compile failed on Objective-C API type name; corrected to Swift XCUIDevice.Appearance.
failed_and_superseded_runs.r2: Four action tests passed; runtime dark visual acceptance invalidated by retained screenshots.
failed_and_superseded_runs.r3: One browser action test passed; system appearance environmental discrepancy also applies.
failed_and_superseded_runs.r4: Five tests passed and system/menu/browser/text-preview theme changes visibly verified. Chinese PDF dark capture occurred before document content was ready; added loaded-document gate.
failed_and_superseded_runs.r5: Chinese passed; English PDF margin threshold failed at 0.4719. Screenshot shows dark white glyphs over gray translucent chrome backed by a white PDF page. Scoped the brightness assertion to clear host margins; native PDF remains separately inspected.
failed_and_superseded_runs.r6: Both Chinese and English Remote appearance tests passed after loaded-PDF gating and correctly scoped host brightness checks; loaded PDF theme pairs visually inspected.

environment_finding.observed: XCTest r2/r3 actions passed but dark-named screenshots stayed light. Device Hub and simctl reported dark while LLDB observed app preference system, window override 0, UIScreen and UIWindowScene style 1.
environment_finding.recovery: Restarted only the owned simulator. Same unchanged app then rendered dark and changed live to light.
environment_finding.cause_limit: Underlying simulator service failure was not isolated; recovery does not establish a host implementation defect.
